name: Trinkets...
summary: After Set Them Ablaze!, you find the Hoard of the Black Dragonflight in Searing Gorge.

sections.title: A Locked Chest
sections.body: The Hoard of the Black Dragonflight waits in Searing Gorge after the towers burn. The chest looks locked, and it is yours to open.

sections.title: At Your Touch
sections.body: The chest opens at your touch without a key. Inside lies a black dragonflight molt. Could there be cheese in there? The only way to know is to look.

faq.q: What is the Hoard of the Black Dragonflight?
aliases: what is hoard of the black dragonflight
faq.answer: The Hoard of the Black Dragonflight is a chest in Searing Gorge that appears after Set Them Ablaze!. It looks locked.
Set Them Ablaze!, when you set fire to the towers of Searing Gorge.

faq.q: What are you asked to do with the chest?
aliases: what to do with the chest
faq.answer: You are asked to open the chest. It looks locked, but opening it is all that is asked of you.
